Named for Yaquina John, a chief of the Yaquina Tribe and an 1855 Treaty signer. He spoke Yaquina, Alsea and Tillamook dialects. In the 1850s, he lived in Yaquina Bay, now known as the City of Newport. He was removed from his ancestral home and moved to Alsea Bay, where Yaquina John Point is located.
